translations.literal: Promoted to Collator of Documents and concurrently Compiler of the Bureau of Military Affairs, then transferred to Instructor at the Princes' Primary and Advanced Schools.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to collating secretary and concurrent compiler at the military affairs bureau, then became instructor at the princes' schools.

sentences.zh: 疏奏：「權奸不可復用，國本不可不早定。」

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "The powerful traitor must not be reused; the foundation of the state cannot go undecided for long."
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial: "The powerful minister must never be restored to office, and the succession cannot be left undecided."

sentences.zh: 帝善其言。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved what he said.

sentences.zh: 遷樞密院編修官兼權屯田郎官。

translations.literal: Transferred to Compiler of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Supervisor of the Garrison-Colony Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He became a military affairs compiler and acting supervisor of the garrison-colony bureau.

sentences.zh: 遷著作佐郎兼侍右郎官，兼樞密院編修官。

translations.literal: Transferred to Assistant Compiler of the Institute for the Compilation of Dynastic Histories, concurrently Secretary on the Right, and concurrently Compiler of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was made assistant historiographer, concurrent secretary on the right, and continued as military affairs compiler.

sentences.zh: 尋兼國史院編修官、實錄檢討官。

translations.literal: Soon concurrently Compiler of the National History Institute and Examiner of the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he also served as compiler of the national history and examiner of the veritable records.

sentences.zh: 江東提點刑獄，加直秘閣，特授尚書司封員外郎，進直寶章閣，尋加寶謨閣，移浙東。

translations.literal: Judicial intendant for criminal cases in Jiangdong; added as Attendant in the Secret Repository; specially appointed Deputy Director of the Ministry of Personnel's Office of Seals and Credentials; advanced to Attendant in the Baozhang Pavilion; soon added Baomo Pavilion; transferred to eastern Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: As judicial intendant for Jiangdong, he was made attendant in the Secret Repository, specially appointed deputy director in the personnel ministry, promoted to Baozhang Pavilion attendant, soon granted Baomo Pavilion status, and transferred to eastern Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 召為國子司業兼資善堂讚讀，兼玉牒所檢討官，時暫兼侍立修注官。

translations.literal: Summoned as Vice Director of the Directorate of Education and concurrent Reader for the Hall of Heir-Apparent Fostering, concurrently Examiner at the Imperial Genealogy Office, and at the time temporarily also Drafter on Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as vice director of the Directorate of Education and reader to the Heir-Apparent Fostering Hall, with concurrent duties examining the imperial genealogy and, for a time, drafting while in attendance.

sentences.zh: 拜宗正少卿兼國子司業。

translations.literal: Appointed Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court and concurrently Vice Director of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice director of the imperial clan court while retaining his post as vice director of the directorate of education.

sentences.zh: 進直龍圖閣、知隆興府。

translations.literal: Advanced to Attendant in the Dragon Diagram Hall and appointed prefect of Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to Dragon Diagram Hall attendant, he became prefect of Longxing.

sentences.zh: 試國子祭酒兼侍立修注官。

translations.literal: Tried as National University Chancellor and concurrently Drafter on Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: He served in an acting capacity as national university chancellor and drafter on attendance.

sentences.zh: 拜太常少卿，仍兼資善堂翊善。

translations.literal: Appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, still concurrently Assistant Instructor of the Hall of Heir-Apparent Fostering.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice director of the court of imperial sacrifices while continuing as assistant instructor to the fostered heir.

sentences.zh: 權工部侍郎兼國史院編修官、實錄院檢討官。

translations.literal: Acting Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works, concurrently Compiler of the National History Institute and Examiner at the Veritable Records Institute.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting vice minister of works and concurrent compiler of the national history and examiner of the veritable records.

sentences.zh: 遷工部侍郎，時暫兼禮部侍郎，兼權吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works, at the time temporarily also Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites, and concurrently Acting Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Made vice minister of works, he briefly doubled as vice minister of rites and acting minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 加端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事，差兼同提舉編修《經武要略》。

translations.literal: Added as Academician of the Duanming Hall and Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, assigned concurrently to jointly direct the compilation of the Jingwu Yaolüe.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Duanming Hall academician and associate commissioner of military affairs, with concurrent charge of compiling the Essentials of Statecraft and Warfare.

sentences.zh: 同知樞密院事，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, appointed Councilor-in-Chief of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: As vice commissioner of military affairs, he was appointed assistant counselor of state.

sentences.zh: 落職予祠，起居郎林存請加竄削，從之。

translations.literal: Dismissed from office and granted a temple post; Attendance Recorder Lin Cun requested additional demotion and stripping of honors; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Stripped of office and given a sinecure, he faced demands from attendance recorder Lin Cun for further punishment, which the court granted.

sentences.zh: 未逾年，復端明殿學士、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: Before a year had passed, restored as Academician of the Duanming Hall and as superintendent of the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year he was restored as Duanming Hall academician and made superintendent of the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 乞致仕。

translations.literal: He requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 轉一官，守本官職致仕。

translations.literal: Promoted one rank, and with his original post preserved, retired.
translations.idiomatic: The court promoted him one rank and let him retire while retaining his honorary title.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡文簡，以犯祖諱，更諡文肅。

translations.literal: He died; posthumous title Wenjian; because it violated an ancestral taboo, changed to Wensu.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was given the posthumous name "Refined and Simple," which was later changed to "Refined and Stern" because it clashed with an ancestral name.

sentences.zh: 張磻，字渭老，福州人。

translations.literal: Zhang Pan, courtesy name Weilao, was a native of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pan, whose courtesy name was Weilao, came from Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 嘉定四年進士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiading he attained the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in 1211.

sentences.zh: 歷官辟點檢贍軍激賞酒庫所主管文字，差主管尚書吏部架閣。

translations.literal: Through successive appointments he was recruited as drafter for the Grain-and-Fortification Ration Army Grant-and-Reward Wine Warehouse Inspection Office, then assigned to supervise archival documents of the Ministry of Personnel in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In successive posts he served as drafter for the military reward wine warehouse, then supervised personnel ministry archives in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 遷太常博士、宗正丞兼權兵部郎官。

translations.literal: Transferred to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Director of the Imperial Clan Court, and concurrently Acting Supervisor of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He became a court of sacrifices erudite, imperial clan director, and acting war ministry supervisor.

sentences.zh: 遷國子祭酒，時暫兼權禮部侍郎，尋為真，兼國史編修、實錄檢討。

translations.literal: Transferred to National University Chancellor, at the time temporarily also Acting Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites, soon made permanent, concurrently Compiler of the National History and Examiner of the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: He was made national university chancellor, briefly acting vice minister of rites before receiving the title permanently, and served concurrently as national history compiler and veritable records examiner.

sentences.zh: 加集英殿修撰，差知婺州。

translations.literal: Added as Compiler of the Hall for Assembling Excellence, and assigned prefect of Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Raised to Hall for Assembling Excellence compiler, he was sent to govern Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 復為禮部侍郎、權兵部尚書，時暫兼權吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Again made Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites and Acting Minister of the Ministry of War, at the time temporarily also Acting Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as vice minister of rites and acting war minister, briefly doubling as acting personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 以右補闕程元鳳論罷。

translations.literal: Dismissed on impeachment by Remonstrance Clerk on the Right Cheng Yuanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance clerk Cheng Yuanfeng's memorial brought about his dismissal.

sentences.zh: 寶祐三年，復權刑部尚書兼侍讀，拜端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事，升同知樞密院事兼參知政事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Baoyou, again Acting Minister of the Ministry of Punishments and concurrently Instructor-in-Waiting; appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall and Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Councilor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1255 he resumed as acting minister of punishment and reader-in-waiting, became Duanming Hall academician and associate military commissioner, then rose to vice commissioner and assistant counselor of state.

sentences.zh: 五年，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Councilor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 he was appointed assistant counselor of state.

sentences.zh: 進封長樂郡公，轉三官，守參知政事致仕。

translations.literal: Advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Changle Commandery; promoted three ranks; with Councilor-in-Chief preserved, retired.
translations.idiomatic: Created duke of Changle commandery, advanced three ranks, and retired with the rank of assistant counselor preserved.

sentences.zh: 九月，卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 遺表上，贈少師。

translations.literal: His deathbed memorial was submitted; posthumously appointed Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: After his final memorial reached the throne, the court posthumously appointed him junior preceptor.

sentences.zh: 馬天驥，字德夫，衢州人。

translations.literal: Ma Tianji, courtesy name Defu, was a native of Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Tianji, whose courtesy name was Defu, came from Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 紹定二年進士，補簽書領南判官廳公事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoding he attained the jinshi degree and was assigned as supplementing associate secretary for the affairs of the Southern District Judge's Office.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of 1229, he was appointed supplemental associate secretary in the southern district judge's office.

sentences.zh: 遷秘書省正字兼沂靖惠王府教授。

translations.literal: Transferred to Rectifier in the Secretariat and concurrently Instructor of the Yi-Jing-Hui Princes' Mansion.
translations.idiomatic: He became a secretariat rectifier and instructor at the Yi-Jing-Hui princes' mansion.

sentences.zh: 遷秘書省校書郎，升著作佐郎。

translations.literal: Transferred to Collator in the Secretariat, promoted to Assistant Compiler of the Institute for the Compilation of Dynastic Histories.
translations.idiomatic: He was made secretariat collator and promoted to assistant historiographer.

sentences.zh: 輪對，假司馬光五規之名，條上時敝，詞旨切直。

translations.literal: At a rotating audience he borrowed the name of Sima Guang's Five Admonitions and itemized the age's ills; his wording was pointed and direct.
translations.idiomatic: In a rotating audience he invoked Sima Guang's "Five Admonitions" to lay out the empire's ills in frank, forceful terms.

sentences.zh: 遷考功郎官，入對，言：「周世宗當天下四分五裂之餘，一念振刷，猶能轉弱為強，陛下有能致之資，乘可為之勢，一轉移間耳。」

translations.literal: Transferred to Supervisor of the Bureau of Evaluations; at an audience he said: "When Emperor Shizong of Zhou faced a realm still split four and five ways, with a single thought of renewal he could still turn weakness into strength. Your Majesty possesses the resources to bring this about; seize the opportune moment—it is but a turn of the hand."
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to supervisor in the bureau of evaluations, he told the emperor at an audience: "After the realm had been torn apart, Emperor Shizong of Zhou with one resolve to reform still turned weakness into strength. Your Majesty has what it takes to do the same; seize the moment that is yours—it is only a matter of turning your mind."

sentences.zh: 遷秘書監、直秘閣、知吉州。

translations.literal: Transferred to Director of the Secretariat, Attendant in the Secret Repository, and appointed prefect of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He became director of the secretariat, attendant in the Secret Repository, and prefect of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 遷宗正少卿，以秘閣修撰知紹興府，主管浙東安撫司公事兼提舉常平。

translations.literal: Transferred to Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court; as Compiler of the Secret Repository he was appointed prefect of Shaoxing Prefecture, directed the affairs of the Eastern Zhejiang Pacification Commission, and concurrently supervised the Ever-Normal Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Made vice director of the imperial clan court, he governed Shaoxing as secret repository compiler, directed the eastern Zhejiang pacification commission, and concurrently oversaw the ever-normal granaries.

sentences.zh: 權兵部侍郎，授沿海制置使，差知慶元府。

translations.literal: Acting Vice Minister of the Ministry of War; appointed Coastal Pacification Commissioner; assigned prefect of Qingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting vice minister of war, was made coastal pacification commissioner, and was sent to govern Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 改知池州兼江東提舉常平。

translations.literal: Changed to prefect of Chizhou and concurrently Superintendent of the Ever-Normal Granaries in Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to govern Chizhou while also supervising ever-normal granaries in Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 改知廣州兼廣東經略安撫使。

translations.literal: Changed to prefect of Guangzhou and concurrently Military Commissioner and Pacification Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as prefect of Guangzhou and military commissioner and pacifier of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 寶祐四年，遷禮部侍郎，兼直學士院，兼侍讀，兼國子祭酒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Baoyou, transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites, concurrently Attendant in the Hanlin Academy, concurrently Instructor-in-Waiting, and concurrently National University Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 he became vice minister of rites, with concurrent posts in the Hanlin Academy, as reader-in-waiting, and as national university chancellor.

sentences.zh: 拜端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事，封信安郡侯。

translations.literal: Appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall and Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and enfeoffed as Marquis of Xin'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Duanming Hall academician and associate commissioner of military affairs, and created marquis of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 五年，以殿中侍御史朱熠、右正言戴慶炣、監察御史吳衍翁應弼等論罷，依舊職提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, on impeachment by Palace Attendance Censor Zhu Yi, Remonstrance Clerk on the Right Dai Qingke, Supervising Censors Wu Yan and Weng Yingbi, and others, he was dismissed and restored to his former duties as superintendent of the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 palace censor Zhu Yi, remonstrance clerk Dai Qingke, supervising censors Wu Yan and Weng Yingbi, and others brought about his dismissal, and he returned to his old post as superintendent of the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 景定元年，知衢州，以兵部侍郎章鑒論罷。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingding, as prefect of Quzhou, dismissed on impeachment by Vice Minister of the Ministry of War Zhang Jian.
translations.idiomatic: In 1260, while governing Quzhou, he was dismissed after war vice minister Zhang Jian impeached him.

sentences.zh: 有旨，依舊職予祠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that with his former post preserved he be granted a temple appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered him given a sinecure while retaining his former rank.

sentences.zh: 起知福州、福建安撫使，以職事修舉，升大學士。

translations.literal: Recalled as prefect of Fuzhou and Pacification Commissioner of Fujian; because his duties were well performed, advanced to Grand Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to govern Fuzhou and pacify Fujian, he was promoted to grand academician for the competence of his administration.

sentences.zh: 改知平江府。

translations.literal: Changed to prefect of Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to govern Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 又改知慶元府兼沿海制置使，提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: Again changed to prefect of Qingyuan Prefecture and concurrently Coastal Pacification Commissioner; superintendent of the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made prefect of Qingyuan and coastal pacification commissioner, and also superintendent of the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 褫職罷祠。

translations.literal: Stripped of office and dismissed from his temple post.
translations.idiomatic: His offices were stripped and his sinecure revoked.

sentences.zh: 咸淳三年，追奪執政恩數，送信州居住。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianchun, the favors granted as a chief councilor were stripped away, and he was sent to reside in Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1267 the court stripped him of the privileges of his former chief-counselor rank and banished him to reside in Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，放令自便，後卒於家。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was released to go where he pleased; later he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In 1268 he was allowed to go where he wished; he later died at home.

sentences.zh: 朱熠，溫州平陽人。

translations.literal: Zhu Yi, a native of Pingyang in Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yi came from Pingyang in Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 端平二年，武舉第一。

translations.literal: In the second year of Duanping, first place in the military examination.
translations.idiomatic: In 1235 he placed first in the military examination.

sentences.zh: 遷閣門舍人，差知沅州，改橫州，復為閣門舍人、知雷州。

translations.literal: Transferred to Attendant of the Gate of the Phoenix Tower; assigned prefect of Yuanzhou; changed to Hengzhou; again made Attendant of the Gate and prefect of Leizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He became an attendant of the Gate of the Phoenix Tower, was sent to govern Yuanzhou, transferred to Hengzhou, and again served as gate attendant while governing Leizhou.

sentences.zh: 入對，為監察御史陳垓論罷；

translations.literal: At an audience, dismissed on impeachment by Supervising Censor Chen Gai;
translations.idiomatic: At an audience he was dismissed after supervising censor Chen Gai impeached him;

sentences.zh: 臣僚復論，降一官。

translations.literal: the court officials again impeached him, and he was demoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: further memorials from officials led to a demotion of one rank.

sentences.zh: 久之，授帶禦器械兼幹辦皇城司，差知興國軍。

translations.literal: After a long while, appointed Bearer of the Imperial Arms and concurrently Director of Affairs in the Imperial City Bureau; assigned military commissioner of Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: Long afterward he was made bearer of the imperial arms and director of affairs in the imperial city bureau, and sent to govern Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 遷度支郎官，拜監察御史兼崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: Transferred to Supervisor of the Bureau of Revenue; appointed Supervising Censor and concurrently Lecturer at the Hall of Exalted Governance.
translations.idiomatic: He became supervisor in the bureau of revenue, then supervising censor and lecturer at the Hall of Exalted Governance.

sentences.zh: 擢右正言，殿中侍御史兼侍講，遷侍御史。

translations.literal: Promoted to Remonstrance Clerk on the Right, Palace Attendance Censor and concurrently Instructor-in-Waiting, then transferred to Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to remonstrance clerk on the right, palace censor and lecturer-in-waiting, then became attending censor.

sentences.zh: 寶祐六年，遷左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Baoyou, transferred to Remonstrance-in-Chief on the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In 1258 he was made chief remonstrance officer on the left.

sentences.zh: 拜端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事，同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall and Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Duanming Hall academician and associate commissioner of military affairs, then vice commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 開慶元年，拜參知政事兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiqing, appointed Councilor-in-Chief and Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In 1259 he was appointed assistant counselor of state and acting commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 景定元年，知樞密院事兼參知政事，兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingding, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Councilor-in-Chief, and concurrently Guest of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In 1260 he served as commissioner of military affairs and assistant counselor of state, and concurrently as guest of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 以舊職知慶元府、沿海制置使。

translations.literal: With his former posts, prefect of Qingyuan Prefecture and Coastal Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to his former posts as prefect of Qingyuan and coastal pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 奉祠。

translations.literal: Granted a temple appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He was given a sinecure.

sentences.zh: 為監察御史胡用虎論罷。

translations.literal: Dismissed on impeachment by Supervising Censor Hu Yonghu.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor Hu Yonghu's memorial brought about his dismissal.

sentences.zh: 久之，監察御史張桂、常茂相繼糾劾，送處州居住。

translations.literal: After a long while, Supervising Censors Zhang Gui and Chang Mao in succession impeached him, and he was sent to reside in Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Long afterward supervising censors Zhang Gui and Chang Mao impeached him in turn, and he was banished to reside in Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 咸淳四年，詔令自便。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianchun, an edict allowed him to go where he pleased.
translations.idiomatic: In 1268 an edict permitted him to go where he wished.

sentences.zh: 五年，侍御史章鑒復以為言，驅之還鄉，尋卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Attending Censor Zhang Jian again spoke against him; he was driven back to his home district, and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1269 attending censor Zhang Jian again memorialized against him; he was driven back to his native place and soon died.

sentences.zh: 熠居言路彈劾最多，一時名士若徐清叟、呂中、尤焴、馬廷鸞，亦皆不免云。

translations.literal: Yi, holding the censorial route, impeached more than any other; eminent men of the time such as Xu Qingsou, Lu Zhong, You Yun, and Ma Tingluan were none of them spared, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: On the censorial track Yi impeached more than anyone; even leading figures of the day such as Xu Qingsou, Lu Zhong, You Yun, and Ma Tingluan did not escape his attacks.

sentences.zh: 饒虎臣

translations.literal: Rao Huchen
translations.idiomatic: Rao Huchen

sentences.zh: 饒虎臣，字宗召，寧國人。

translations.literal: Rao Huchen, courtesy name Zongzhao, was a native of Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: Rao Huchen, whose courtesy name was Zongzhao, came from Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 嘉定七年進士。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiading he attained the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in 1214.

sentences.zh: 歷官遷將作監主簿，差知徽州。

translations.literal: Through successive appointments, transferred to Registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, and assigned prefect of Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In successive posts he rose to registrar in the directorate of palace buildings and was sent to govern Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 遷秘書郎，升著作郎兼權右司郎官。

translations.literal: Transferred to Secretary in the Secretariat, promoted to Compiler and concurrently Acting Supervisor of the Right Office.
translations.idiomatic: He became a secretariat secretary, then historiographer and acting supervisor in the right office.

sentences.zh: 遷兵部郎官兼權左司郎官，特授左司郎中。

translations.literal: Transferred to Supervisor of the Ministry of War and concurrently Acting Supervisor of the Left Office; specially appointed Director of the Left Office.
translations.idiomatic: He became war ministry supervisor and acting left-office supervisor, then was specially appointed director of the left office.

sentences.zh: 遷司農少卿兼左司，兼國史編修、實錄檢討。

translations.literal: Transferred to Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and concurrently the Left Office, and concurrently Compiler of the National History and Examiner of the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice director of the ministry of revenue with charge of the left office, and concurrently served as national history compiler and veritable records examiner.

sentences.zh: 遷司農卿、直龍圖閣、福建轉運判官，浙東提點刑獄。

translations.literal: Transferred to Director of the Ministry of Revenue, Attendant in the Dragon Diagram Hall, Transport Commissioner of Fujian, and Judicial Intendant for Criminal Cases in Eastern Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He became director of the ministry of revenue, Dragon Diagram Hall attendant, Fujian transport commissioner, and judicial intendant for eastern Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 拜太府卿兼中書門下檢正諸房公事。

translations.literal: Appointed Director of the Palace Storehouse and concurrently Rectifier of the Various Offices of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed director of the palace storehouse and rectifier of the various offices under the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 以秘閣修撰、兩浙轉運使權禮部侍郎，尋為真。

translations.literal: As Compiler of the Secret Repository and Transport Commissioner of the Two Zhes, Acting Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites; soon made permanent.
translations.idiomatic: As secret repository compiler and transport commissioner for the two Zhes, he served as acting vice minister of rites and soon received the title permanently.

sentences.zh: 時暫兼權侍右侍郎。

translations.literal: At the time temporarily also Acting Vice Minister of the Right Office of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: For a time he also served as acting vice minister of the right secretariat office.

sentences.zh: 寶祐六年，兼同修國史、實錄院同修撰，暫通攝吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Baoyou, concurrently Associate Compiler of the National History and Associate Compiler of the Veritable Records Institute, and for a time in general charge acting as Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In 1258 he also served as associate compiler of the national history and veritable records, and for a time acted in overall charge as minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 拜端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall and Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Academician of the Duanming Hall and Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 開慶元年，同知樞密院事，兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiqing he was made Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs while also acting as Vice Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In 1259 (Kaiqing 1) he became Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs and acting Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 景定元年，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingding he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In 1260 (Jingding 1) he was made Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史何夢然論罷，以資政殿學士提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: Attending Censor within the Palace He Mengran memorialized for his dismissal; he was made Academician of the Zizheng Hall with charge of the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Attending Censor He Mengran memorialized for his dismissal; he was made Academician of the Zizheng Hall with charge of the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 夢然再劾之，褫職罷祠。

translations.literal: Mengran impeached him again; his office was stripped and his sinecure post revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Mengran impeached him again; he was stripped of rank and dismissed from his sinecure.

sentences.zh: 四年，敘復元官，提舉太平興國宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was restored by seniority to his original office and given charge of the Taiping Xingguo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was restored to his former rank and given charge of the Taiping Xingguo Palace.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年，禮部侍郎王應麟、右史徐宗仁乞追復元官，守資政殿學士致仕。

translations.literal: In the first year of Deyou, Vice Minister of Rites Wang Yinglin and Right Historiographer Xu Zongren requested restoration of his original office; he was to hold the rank of Academician of the Zizheng Hall in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 (Deyou 1), Vice Minister of Rites Wang Yinglin and Right Historiographer Xu Zongren petitioned to restore his former rank; he was permitted to retire as Academician of the Zizheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 戴慶炣

translations.literal: Dai Qingke
translations.idiomatic: Dai Qingke

sentences.zh: 戴慶炣，字彥可，溫州永嘉人。

translations.literal: Dai Qingke, courtesy name Yanke, was a man of Yongjia in Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Qingke, styled Yanke, was from Yongjia in Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 淳祐十年進士。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Chunyou he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the tenth year of Chunyou (1250).

sentences.zh: 歷官差主管戶部架閣文字。

translations.literal: He served in office as assigned supervisor of Ministry of Revenue archive documents.
translations.idiomatic: He served as assigned supervisor of Ministry of Revenue archive documents.

sentences.zh: 召試館職，遷秘書省正字兼史館校勘。

translations.literal: He was summoned to examination for an academy post, was promoted to Proofreader of the Secretariat while also collator at the Historiography Institute.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to examination for an academy post, he was made Proofreader of the Secretariat and collator at the Historiography Institute.

sentences.zh: 升校書郎，遷右正言、左司諫、殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Collator, then made Right Rectifier, Left Bureau Remonstrator, and Attending Censor within the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Collator, then Right Rectifier, Left Bureau Remonstrator, and Attending Censor within the Palace.

sentences.zh: 升侍御史。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 開慶元年，拜右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiqing he was appointed Right Remonstrance Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: In 1259 he was made Right Remonstrance Grandee.

sentences.zh: 尋加端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事，同知樞密院事兼參知政事。

translations.literal: Soon after he was given the added titles of Academician of the Duanming Hall and Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs while also acting as Vice Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, then made Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs while also Vice Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was made Academician of the Duanming Hall and Signatory of Military Affairs with acting duty as Vice Grand Councillor, then Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs and Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 未幾，守本官致仕。

translations.literal: Before long he retired while retaining his original office.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he retired while retaining his rank.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈特進、資政殿大學士。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously given the rank of Special Advancement and Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made Special Advancement and Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 皮龍榮

translations.literal: Pi Longrong
translations.idiomatic: Pi Longrong

sentences.zh: 皮龍榮，字起霖，一字季遠，潭州醴陵人。

translations.literal: Pi Longrong, courtesy name Qilin, also styled Jiyuan, was a man of Liling in Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Pi Longrong, styled Qilin and also known as Jiyuan, was from Liling in Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 淳祐四年進士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunyou he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the fourth year of Chunyou (1244).

sentences.zh: 歷官主管吏部架閣文字，遷宗學諭，授諸王宮大小學教授兼資善堂直講。

translations.literal: He served in office as supervisor of Ministry of Personnel archive documents, was promoted to Instructor of the Imperial Clan School, and appointed professor of the great and small schools of the Princes' Palaces while also direct lecturer at the Hall of Cherishing Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: He served as supervisor of Ministry of Personnel archive documents, was made Instructor of the Imperial Clan School, and appointed professor in the princes' schools while also direct lecturer at the Hall of Cherishing Goodness.

sentences.zh: 入對，請「以改過之實，易運化之名，一過改而一善著，百過改而百善融。」

translations.literal: Presenting himself at audience, he requested: "With the reality of correcting faults, change the name of transforming fortune; one fault corrected and one good made manifest, a hundred faults corrected and a hundred goods blended together."
translations.idiomatic: At audience he urged: "Let the reality of reform replace empty talk of transformation; correct one fault and one virtue will shine forth; correct a hundred faults and a hundred virtues will take root."

sentences.zh: 遷秘書郎，升著作郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Secretary and advanced to Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Secretary, then Compiler.

sentences.zh: 入對，因及真德秀、崔與之廉，龍榮曰：「今天下豈無廉者，願陛下崇獎之以風天下，執賞罰之公以示勸懲。」

translations.literal: Presenting himself at audience, because Zhen Dexiu and Cui Yuzhi's integrity were mentioned, Longrong said: "Under Heaven today are there not men of integrity? Your Majesty should exalt and reward them to set the wind for the realm, and hold to fairness in rewards and punishments to show encouragement and warning."
translations.idiomatic: At audience, when Zhen Dexiu and Cui Yuzhi's integrity came up, Longrong said: "Surely the realm still has upright men. Your Majesty should honor and reward them to set an example for all, and hold rewards and punishments fairly to encourage the good and warn the bad."

sentences.zh: 帝以為然。

translations.literal: The emperor thought this correct.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 兼兵部郎官、差知嘉興府。

translations.literal: He held concurrent duty as Ministry of War Gentleman and was assigned to know Jiaxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He held concurrent duty as Ministry of War Gentleman and was assigned prefect of Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 召赴闕，遷侍右郎官兼資善堂贊讀。

translations.literal: Summoned to court, he was transferred to Attendant Right Bureau Gentleman with concurrent Praise-Reader at the Hall of Cherishing Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to court, he was made Attendant Right Bureau Gentleman with concurrent Praise-Reader at the Hall of Cherishing Goodness.

sentences.zh: 又遷吏部員外郎兼直講。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel with concurrent Direct Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel with concurrent Direct Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 入對，言：「忠王之學，願陛下身教之於內。」

translations.literal: At audience he said: "As for the Loyal Prince's studies, I wish Your Majesty would personally teach him within the palace."
translations.idiomatic: At audience he said: "Regarding the Loyal Prince's education, I beg Your Majesty to teach him personally within the inner palace."

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納。

translations.literal: The emperor approved and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 遷將作監兼尚右郎官，秘書少監兼吏部郎中，宗正少卿、起居郎兼權侍左侍郎，兼給事中，吏部侍郎兼贊讀，封醴陵縣男。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Director of Palace Construction with concurrent Senior Right Bureau Gentleman, Vice Director of the Secretariat with concurrent Senior Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel, Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan and Senior Diarist with acting Attendant Left Vice Minister, concurrently Censor-in-Chief, Vice Minister of Personnel with concurrent Praise-Reader, and enfeoffed as Baron of Liling County.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted through a series of posts—Director of Palace Construction and Senior Right Bureau Gentleman; Vice Director of the Secretariat and Ministry of Personnel Senior Gentleman; Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan and Senior Diarist with acting Attendant Left Vice Minister; Censor-in-Chief; Vice Minister of Personnel and Praise-Reader—and was enfeoffed as Baron of Liling.

sentences.zh: 遷集賢殿修撰、提舉太平興國宮。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Compiler at the Hall for Gathering Excellence and made superintendent of the Taiping Xingguo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Compiler at the Hall for Gathering Excellence and superintendent of the Taiping Xingguo Palace.

sentences.zh: 召見，進刑部侍郎，加寶章閣待制、荊湖南路轉運使，權刑部尚書兼翊善。

translations.literal: Summoned to audience, he was advanced to Vice Minister of Punishments, given the additional titles of Academician Awaiting Orders at the Baozhang Pavilion and Transport Commissioner of Jinghu South Circuit, and made acting Minister of Punishments with concurrent Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Called to audience, he was advanced to Vice Minister of Punishments, made Academician Awaiting Orders at the Baozhang Pavilion and Transport Commissioner of Jinghu South Circuit, and given acting duty as Minister of Punishments with concurrent tutor to the heir.

sentences.zh: 景定元年四月，拜端明殿學士、簽書樞密院，進封伯。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Jingding he was appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall and Signing Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and advanced to enfeoffment as Earl.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1260 (Jingding 1) he was appointed Duanming Hall academician and Signing Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs and advanced to the rank of earl.

sentences.zh: 權參知政事兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: He was given acting duty as Vice Grand Councillor with concurrent Host of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was given acting duty as Vice Grand Councillor and Host of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二年，拜參知政事，仍兼太子賓客，封壽沙郡公。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed Vice Grand Councillor, still holding concurrent Host of the Heir Apparent, and enfeoffed as Duke of Shousha Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made Vice Grand Councillor, retaining his post as Host of the Heir Apparent, and enfeoffed as Duke of Shousha.

sentences.zh: 三年，罷為湖南安撫使，判潭州。

translations.literal: In the third year he was dismissed and made Hunan Pacification Commissioner with concurrent administration of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was dismissed from the center and made Hunan Pacification Commissioner with charge of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，以資政殿大學士提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, as Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall he administered the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he retired as Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall to administer the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 以右正言曹孝慶論罷。

translations.literal: He was dismissed on criticism by Right Rectifier Cao Xiaoqing.
translations.idiomatic: Right Rectifier Cao Xiaoqing memorialized for his dismissal.

sentences.zh: 咸淳元年，以舊職奉祠。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianchun he held his former post in a sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: In 1265 he returned to his former sinecure post.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史陳宗禮、監察御史林拾先後論劾，削一官。

translations.literal: Attending Censor within the Palace Chen Zongli and Investigating Censor Lin Shi impeached him in succession, and one rank was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Attending Censor Chen Zongli and Investigating Censor Lin Shi impeached him in turn, and he was demoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 它日，帝偶問龍榮安在，賈似道恐其召用，陰諷湖南提點刑獄李雷應劾之。

translations.literal: Another day the emperor happened to ask where Longrong was; Jia Sidao feared he might be recalled and secretly prompted Li Leiying, Hunan Judicial Intendant, to impeach him.
translations.idiomatic: One day the emperor happened to ask after Longrong; Jia Sidao, fearing he might be recalled, secretly prompted Hunan Judicial Intendant Li Leiying to impeach him.

sentences.zh: 雷應至官，謁龍榮，龍榮託故不出；

translations.literal: When Leiying reached his post he called on Longrong, but Longrong pleaded an excuse and would not come out;
translations.idiomatic: When Leiying took up his post he called on Longrong, but Longrong made excuses and refused to receive him;

sentences.zh: 既退，又斥罵之。

translations.literal: after Leiying had left, he again reviled him.
translations.idiomatic: and after Leiying left, he reviled him again.

sentences.zh: 或以語雷應，不能平，遂疏其罪，又謂每對人言，有「吾擁至尊於膝上」之語。

translations.literal: Someone reported this to Leiying; unable to bear it, he memorialized his crimes, also saying that whenever he spoke to others he had the words, "I hold the Sovereign on my knee."
translations.idiomatic: When word reached Leiying, he could not endure it and memorialized Longrong's offenses, alleging that Longrong often told others, "I hold the Sovereign on my knee."

sentences.zh: 詔徙衡州居住。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him transferred to reside at Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict banished him to reside at Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 湖南提刑治衡州，龍榮恐不為雷應所容，未至而歿。

translations.literal: The Hunan judicial intendant governed Hengzhou; Longrong feared he would not be tolerated by Leiying and died before arriving.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Hunan judicial intendant governed Hengzhou, Longrong feared Leiying would not tolerate him and died before he could go there.

sentences.zh: 龍榮少有志略，精於《春秋》學，有文集三十卷。

translations.literal: Longrong from youth had resolve and strategic ability, was expert in the study of the Spring and Autumn Annals, and had a collection of writings in thirty juan.
translations.idiomatic: Longrong had shown resolve and strategic ability from youth, was expert in Spring and Autumn studies, and left collected works in thirty juan.

sentences.zh: 性伉直，似道當國，不肯降志。

translations.literal: By nature he was upright and unyielding; when Sidao held power he would not lower his will.
translations.idiomatic: Upright by nature, he refused to bend when Sidao dominated the government.

sentences.zh: 又以度宗舊學，卒為似道所擯。

translations.literal: Moreover, because he had been an old teacher of Duzong, in the end he was ostracized by Sidao.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had been Duzong's former tutor, he was ultimately driven out by Sidao.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年，復其官致仕。

translations.literal: In the first year of Deyou his office was restored and he was retired.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 his rank was restored and he was granted retirement.

sentences.zh: 二年，太府卿柳岳乞加贈諡，未及行而宋亡。

translations.literal: In the second year Grand Steward Liu Yue requested an additional posthumous enfeoffment and posthumous title, but before it could be carried out the Song fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Grand Steward Liu Yue petitioned for additional posthumous honors, but before the request could be acted on the Song dynasty fell.

sentences.zh: 沈炎，字若晦，嘉興人。

translations.literal: Shen Yan, courtesy name Ruohui, was a man of Jiaxing.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Yan, styled Ruohui, was from Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 寶慶二年進士。

translations.literal: In the second year of Baoqing he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the second year of Baoqing (1226).

sentences.zh: 調嵊縣主簿，廣西經略司準備差遣，湖南安撫司幹辦公事。

translations.literal: He was assigned as registrar of Sheng County, preparatory dispatch of the Guangxi Pacification Commission, and staff officer of the Hunan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as registrar of Sheng County, preparatory officer on the Guangxi Pacification staff, and staff officer on the Hunan Pacification staff.

sentences.zh: 討郴寇有功，改知金華縣，沿江制置司幹官。

translations.literal: He had merit in suppressing the Chen bandits, was transferred to be prefect of Jinhua County, and made staff officer of the Riverine Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in suppressing bandits in Chenzhou, he was made prefect of Jinhua and staff officer on the Riverine Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 通判和州，沿江制置主管機宜文字。

translations.literal: He was made judicial intendant of Hezhou and chief planning officer of the Riverine Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was made judicial intendant of Hezhou and chief planning officer on the Riverine Pacification staff.

sentences.zh: 監三省、樞密院門，樞密院編修官。

translations.literal: He supervised the gates of the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs and was compiler at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised the gates of the Three Departments and Military Affairs Bureau and served as compiler at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 為監察御史、右正言、左司諫、殿中侍御史、侍御史。

translations.literal: He served as Investigating Censor, Right Rectifier, Left Bureau Remonstrator, Attending Censor within the Palace, and Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Investigating Censor, Right Rectifier, Left Bureau Remonstrator, Attending Censor within the Palace, and Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 景定元年，拜右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingding he was appointed Right Remonstrance Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: In 1260 he was made Right Remonstrance Grandee.

sentences.zh: 加端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: He was given the added titles of Academician of the Duanming Hall and Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs while also serving as Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Academician of the Duanming Hall and Associate Signatory of Military Affairs, concurrently Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二年，拜同知樞密院事，兼權參知政事，以資政殿學士提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs while also acting as Vice Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery; he was then made Academician of the Zizheng Hall with charge of the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs and acting Vice Grand Councillor, then Academician of the Zizheng Hall with charge of the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 三年，進大學士，致仕。

translations.literal: In the third year he was advanced to Grand Academician and retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was advanced to Grand Academician and retired.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈少保。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously given the rank of Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 炎居言路，嘗按劾福建轉運使高斯得、觀文殿學士李曾伯、沿江制置司參謀官劉子澄、左丞相吳潛。

translations.literal: While Yan held the path of remonstrance he once prosecuted Fujian transport commissioner Gao Side, Academician of the Guanwen Hall Li Cengbo, planning officer of the Riverine Pacification Commission Liu Zicheng, and Left Chancellor Wu Qian.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as a remonstrator, Yan prosecuted Fujian transport commissioner Gao Side, Guanwen Hall academician Li Cengbo, Riverine Pacification planning officer Liu Zicheng, and Left Chancellor Wu Qian.

sentences.zh: 然論罷右丞相丁大全及其黨與，則為公論也。

translations.literal: Yet in memorializing for the dismissal of Right Chancellor Ding Daquan and his faction, he accorded with public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in bringing down Right Chancellor Ding Daquan and his clique, he won public approval.

sentences.zh: 論曰：王伯大立朝直諒。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Wang Boda stood at court with direct sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: The historians comment: Wang Boda served at court with blunt integrity.

sentences.zh: 鄭寀、沈炎居言路，不辨君子小人，皆彈拄之，吾不知其何說也。

translations.literal: Zheng Cai and Shen Yan, holding the path of remonstrance, did not distinguish gentlemen from petty men and impeached them all—I do not know what principle they followed.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Cai and Shen Yan, as remonstrators, failed to distinguish the upright from the base and impeached them indiscriminately—what principle they followed, I cannot say.

sentences.zh: 應㒡清慎沒世。

translations.literal: Ying You was pure and cautious to the end of his life.
translations.idiomatic: Ying You remained pure and cautious to his dying day.

sentences.zh: 徐清叟風采凜乎班行之間。

translations.literal: Xu Qingsou's bearing was stern among the ranks at court.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qingsou's bearing stood out with stern dignity among his colleagues.

sentences.zh: 李曾伯之治邊，短於才者也。

translations.literal: Li Cengbo's governance of the frontier showed him short in talent.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cengbo's management of the frontier revealed a man lacking in ability.

sentences.zh: 王野得名父師，而其學問益光。

translations.literal: Wang Ye gained a renowned father-teacher, and his learning shone all the brighter.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ye had distinguished teachers, and his scholarship shone all the brighter for it.

sentences.zh: 蔡抗號為君子，史闕其事。

translations.literal: Cai Kang was styled a gentleman; the history lacks his deeds.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Kang was called a gentleman, but the history records little of his deeds.

sentences.zh: 若張磻、馬天驥、饒虎臣未見卓然有可稱道者。

translations.literal: As for Zhang Pan, Ma Tianji, and Rao Huchen, nothing outstanding worth praise has been seen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pan, Ma Tianji, and Rao Huchen show nothing outstanding worth praise.

sentences.zh: 戴慶炣、皮龍榮登第皆未久而位至執政，龍榮不附權臣，為所擯斥而死，猶為可取，慶炣無所稱述焉。

translations.literal: Dai Qingke and Pi Longrong, having passed the examinations, before long reached positions as chief ministers; Longrong did not attach himself to powerful ministers, was ostracized by them and died—this is still worth approval; Qingke has nothing related in praise.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Qingke and Pi Longrong both reached the highest offices soon after passing the examinations; Longrong refused to court powerful ministers, was driven out and died—yet that still merits respect; Qingke has nothing worth recording.

sentences.zh: 朱熠在臺察如狂猘，遇人輒噬之云。

translations.literal: Zhu Yi at the censorate was like a mad mastiff—meeting anyone he would bite, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yi at the censorate was like a rabid dog—so it is said that he snapped at whoever he met.
